tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal ldan sa skya dang ngor e waṃ chos ldan gnyis kyi ring lugs 'dzin pa rnams kyis thog drangs sa lugs yongs rdzogs kyi bstan pa'i sbyin bdag sde dge chos rgyal rin chen gyi thugs dam dad rten thang sku che chung bcu bdun gyi dkar chag ngo mtshar rgya mtsho'i bang mdzod bzhugs so// oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ phyag na ral gri gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i sgyur 'phrul drwa ba'i gar/ /byang phyogs 'di na sa skya par grags skal bzang dga' ba'i gnyen/ /legs bshad rin chen phreng ba blo gsal mgul par 'jog mkhas pa'i/ /thub pa'i rgyal tshab rim par byon pa'i zhabs rdul spyi bos mchod/ /ces pa'i mchod yul dam par gyur pa gangs can bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rje btsun sa skya pa yab sras zhal slob mkhas grub rnams dang bcas pa'i sku brnyan gtso bsdus la bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lhar bcas pa'i sku brnyan rags bsdus kyis bskor ba'i zhal thang che chung 'di dag gi rnam gzhag cung zad zhu na/ de yang mnyam med rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams zab mo chos kyi sku las g.yo ba med bzhin du gdul bya'i khams dang mthun par longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dang sprul pa sna tshogs kyi sgo nas sems can gyi don 'di lta bu mdzad do/ /zhes mtshon byed chos longs gnyis 'dus la rgyal ba khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen po'i sku brnyan/ de'i sprul pa'i sku bsam gyis mi khyab kyang / mi mjed 'jig rten gyi khams snyigs ma lnga dang ldan pa 'di nyid la thugs rje gcig tu che ba ni/ bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po nyid yin pas na/ de'i sku brnyan shākya'i rgyal po 'di nyid sogs rgyal ba rnams kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ brtse ba'i thugs rje 'phags mchog phyag na pad+mo/ nus mthu'i dbang phyug gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ rgyal sras de rnams kyis 'gro la dge ba'i mdzad bzang rlabs po che rnams kyi nang nas bho ṭa'i ljongs 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa spel ba la bsams bzhin byon pa/

rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung gi thog ma rnams lha spyi (lce )ring g.yu ring g.yu se gsum/ g.yu ring gi sras ma sangs spun bdun gyi tha chung ma sangs spyi rje/ de'i sras thog tsha dpa' bo stag de sras klu tsha stag po 'od can/ de sras g.ya' spangs skyes te lha'i gdung rabs/ de sras 'khon par skyes/ de sras dkon pa rje khung (gung )stag gam dpal po che/ de sras klu'i dbang po dang rdo rje rin chen/ de sras 'gro pa mched bdun las chung ba shes rab yon tan la sras gnyis byung ba'i/ che ba yon tan 'byung gnas/ de la sras gsum byung ba'i che ba tshul khrims rgyal po/ de sras gsum gyi che ba rdo rje gtsug tor ram/ gtsug tor shes rab/ de la sras bdun byung ba'i lnga pa 'khon dge skyabs/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba dge mthong / de sras 'khon ston bal po/ de sras shākya blo gros/ de la sras gnyis byung ba'i che ba 'khon rog shes rab tshul khrims te 'khon gyi gdung rabs/ sras chung ba 'khon dkon mchog rgyal pos chu mo glang gi lo khrums kyi zla ba'i yar tshes la bod kyi rdo rje gdan dpal ldan sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rnams kyi phud sgo rum gzims spyil dkar po btab pa nas bzung 'khon gyi gdung rabs la sa skya pa'i mtshan thogs/ bla chen de'i sras yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od zer kun nas 'phags pa dpal brtsegs rgyal po nyid sems dpa'i tshul bzung ba'i sgo nas sems can gyi don la gcig tu dgongs pa thugs rje'i dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid gzhan ngor dge bsnyen mchog gi skur bstan pa dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa brtse chen kun dga' snying po zhes gangs ri'i khrod 'dir 'gran zla thams cad dang bral ba'i skyes chen dam pa de nyid ni rang re sa skya pa rnams kyi chu mgo gangs dkar la thug pa lta bu de yin pas gtso thang la bzhugs shing /

gdung rabs kyi gras la'ang sku brnyan chung ngu re bkod/ de la sras bzhi byon pa'i gcen kun dga' 'bar/ gcung slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo ni chu bo gaṅgā tshun chad la 'gran zla med pa'i mkhas grub chen po sku lus ma spangs par mkha' spyod du gshegs pa de nyid kyi snang brnyan rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la gcig bzhugs/ de'i gcung de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsung gi gsang ba 'dzin pa rje btsun 'khrul pa'i dri bral grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi sku'ang rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la bzhugs/ de'i gcung dpal chen 'od po de la sras gnyis byung ba'i gcen rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs nyid ngur smrig gi bla gos 'chang ba mtshungs med chos kyi rje bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku brnyan yang rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la bzhugs/ gcung zang tsha bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ de la sras bzhi byon pa'i gcen khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po bla chen 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'i sku'ang rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la bzhugs/ gcung 'gro ba'i mgon po phyag na rdo rje/ slob dpon rin chen rgyal mtshan/ slob dpon ye shes 'byung gnas/ 'gro mgon phyag na'i sras dharmā pha la rak+ṣi ta/ de sras rat+na bha dra ye shes 'byung gnas kyi sras 'khon rigs rgya mtsho'i 'byung khungs mkhyen brtse nus mthu'i dbang phyug bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal gyi sku brnyan yang rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la bzhugs/ de nyid la sras mang du byon pa las bsod nams bzang po/ de'i sras rat+na bha dra/ bdag nyid chen po'i sras ti shrī kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams la dpal sa skya'i gdan sa chen po spyi la dbang bsgyur ba'i gdung rabs zhes grags shing / rten gtso bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i sku thang 'di la tshang /

de'i 'og phyogs su rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan srung rnams kyi gtso bo rdo rje nag po chen po gur gyi mgon po'i chos skor la bka' babs bzhi bzhugs pa las thun mong ma yin pa mal lo tsā ba nas brgyud pa'i gur mgon 'khor bcas kyi sku'i rnam gzhag la mi 'dra ba mang yang mchog tu gyur pa lcam dral lha brgyad 'byung po 'dul byed gong gnon du bzhugs pa dang bcas pa la 'o skol mchod yon lhan rgyas gus 'dud kyi tshul du bskor te 'phral yun gyi phan bde rgyas pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas pa lags/ ༈ g.yas dang po'i rten gtso rje btsun sku mched dang / 'jam mgon sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta la rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi gtso bo kyai rdor bka' babs bzhi'i nang nas slob dpon rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa nas shar phyogs nag po pa la brgyud pa man ngag lugs kyi snying po kyai rdo rje/ lū nag dril gsum rnal 'byor gsang mtha' ltar bkral ba'i 'khor lo bde mchog rnams las dbang 'bring rjes su bzung ba lū hi pa'i lugs/ gsang 'dus bka' babs gnyis las 'phags lugs mi bskyod rdo rje/ sa lugs la sku drin che ba'i 'phags yul gyi bla ma rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa 'phags pa klu sgrub/ sangs rgyas gnyis pa slob dpon rin po che pad+ma 'byung gnas/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug 'jigs bral dpal ldan chos skyong / byang chub sems dpa' chen po dpal ldan mar me mdzad rnams dang / bla ma sa skya pa chen po'i dbu bla'i gras/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ 'khon sgyi chu ba dgra lha 'bar rnams dang / bla brang go bzhi'i nang tshan bzhi thog bla brang gi gdung gi thog ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras mkhas btsun nam mkha' legs pa/ de'i gcung nam mkha' bshes gnyen dang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ mkhas btsun pa'i sras ta dbon kun dga' rin chen/ de la sras gsum byung ba'i gcen gug shrī blo gros rgyal mtshan/

gcung slob dpon grags pa blo gros dang slob dpon kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ gug shrī blo rgyal gyi sras kun dga' dbang phyug grags blo pa'i sras blo gros dbang phyug te bzhi thog bla brang pa'i gdung rabs dang / rin chen sgang bla brang pa'i gdung gi thog ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras ta dben kun dga' nyi ma/ de'i gcung 'jam dbyangs don yod rgyal mtshan dang / dpal ldan bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jam dbyangs pa'i sras nyi ma rgyal mtshan dang bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ de sras 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan dang / bdag chen zhwa lu pa mthu stobs dbang phyug bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rnam rgyal ba'i sras sngags 'chang rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan dang / bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ zhwa lu pa'i sras grags pa rgyal mtshan te rin chen sgang pa'i gdung rabs dang / lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung gi thog ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras ti shrī kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dang / ti shrī kun dga' rgyal mtshan de sras ta dben chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gcung ta dben blo gros rgyal mtshan/ ta dben chos rgyal gyi sras theg chen chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' bkra shis dpal bzang po/ dharma dh+wa dza/ de gcung rdo rje rin chen dang / bsod nams bkra shis/ de sras bde legs bkra shis/ de sras bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ shākya seng ge don grub rgyal mtshan/ bsam 'grub rgyal mtshan/ shākya seng ge'i sras kun dga' bkra shis/ kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' snying po/ rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams kyis bskor ba dang / 'og phyogs su rje btsun sa skya pa'i chos skyong che chung gnyis kyi nang tshan dam tshig gi mgon po tsa turmu kha 'di la 'phags yul nas brgyud srol mi 'dra ba kha shas kyi snang yang / 'dir thun mong ma yin pa ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma nas gnyan lo tsā ba la brgyud pa'i lugs 'di la bsnyen sgrub las gsum gyi mgon po'i mngon rtogs sogs rnam grangs mang yang phal cher 'bri mi rung zhing /

bla ma gong ma rnams kyi phyag len la bram gzugs yum bzhi ma 'di dar bas de ltar gyi bkod pa bcas kyi drung du rang cag mchod yon rnams gus 'dud kyi tshul du gnas pa lags/ ༈ g.yon dang po'i rten gtso 'phags pa rin po che dang / bdag nyid chen po sa skya pa'i bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong tshar gsum gyi nang nas rgyal ba'i lung bstan brnyes pa sku drin mtshungs med ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po rnams la rang lugs yab chos rnams kyi gtso bo dpal chen yang dag dang rdo rje phur pa/ gshin rje gshed dmar po rnams dang / sa chen gyi dbu bla'i gras mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ zhang ston chos 'bar rnams dang / lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung rabs kyi 'phros kun dga' rgyal mtshan la sras gnyis byung ba'i gcen chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / gcung 'dam thog bdag chen kun dga' blo gros legs pa'i 'byung gnas dpal bzang po ste lha khang bla brang pa'i gdung rabs dang / dus mchod bla brang pa'i gdung gi thog ma bdag nyid chen po'i sras gcen slob dpon chen po nyi ma dpal/ gcung ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas dpal bzang po/ de sras gcen bla chen bsod nams blo gros/ gcung ngag dbang grags pa rgyal mtshan/ de sras gcen kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / gcung dbang rnam sras rgyal mtshan dang / chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ dbang rnam sras pa'i sras kun dga' blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ gcung dbang nam mkha' legs pa'i rgyal mtshan/ de sras dbang nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ de sras nam mkha' rin chen rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / gcung nam mkha' bkra shis rgyal mtshan/ de sras sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ ngag gi dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ 'jam dpal grags pa 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' don grub sangs rgyas tshe brtan bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/

de la sras gnyis byung ba'i gcen kun dga' bsam 'grub/ de sras kun dga' bde legs bkra shis/ de sras 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams lhun grub/ tshe dbang hor sogs bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ 'jig rten rgya hor ram 'jig rten dbang phyug de sras gcen byams pa/ ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ gcung ngag dbang lhun grub/ de sras gcen bsod nams bstan 'dzin dbang po byams pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ gcung ngag dbang nor bu bsod nams dbang gi rgyal po/ de sras gcen kun dga' tshe dbang rigs 'dzin/ gcung ngag dbang rgyal mtshan te/ rtse gdong pa'i gdung rabs dang / sangs rgyas tshe brtan gyi sras chung ba snyigs dus bstan pa'i nyi ma dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes ci mdzad bstan 'gro'i phan bder gyur zhing / khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i sde bstan pa gdung rgyud dang bcas pa'i bstan pa'i me ro rmang nas gso ba la bsam bzhin byon pa'i skyes chen de nyid kyi sku rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la zhugs/ de sras gcen byams pa dpal ngag dbang bsod nams dbang po grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / gcung bsod nams rgyal mtshan nam grags pa blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de sras gcen sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang gcung ngag dbang kun dga' dbang rgyal grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / de gcung rgyal ba kun gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid yongs rdzogs gnas lnga rig pa'i ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po zhes snyan pa'i ba dan srid pa gsum du g.yo ba de nyid kyi sku rten gtso dang gdung rabs kyi gras la bzhugs/ de sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs ngag dbang bsod nams dbang phyug grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/

de sras ngag dbang kun dga' bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ de sras bdag gi drin chen rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang dpal sa skya pa chen po sngags 'chang bla ma thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rnam 'dren dam pa de nyid kyis kho bo cag spun rnams dal 'byor gyi rten du rjes su bzung ba las kho bo'i nu bo rgyan mchog ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams dang / sa skya pa'i chos srung nor skyong dur khrod kyi bdag po yab yum bcas la rang re mchod yon rnams gus 'dud kyi tshul du bskor ba lags/ ༈ g.yas gnyis pa'i rten gtso chos rje khu dbon nas brgyud pa'i/ sde snod kyi bshad pa dang rigs lam smra ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba byams pa'i rnam sprul g.yag mi pham chos kyi bla ma sangs rgyas dpal/ mkhas mchog ka ma la shrī la'i rnam sprul rong ston shes bya kun rig lnga rig mkhas pa'i dbang po dpal shākya mchog ldan dri med legs pa'i blo gros rnams la dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed rwa lugs dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor lo/ rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos kyi nying khu rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma rnams dang / rje btsun gong ma'i zhal slob kyi gras/ yar sgom se bo/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/ mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ grub pa'i dbang phyug seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams rgyal ba mchog dbyangs te/ yar lung klu pa khu dbon rnams dang / sa lugs bstan 'dzin gyi gtso bo rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang pos dpal e waṃ chos ldan gyi dgon pa btab nas rang lugs kyi yab chos rgyud gsum man ngag dang bcas pa gtso gyur gyi rgyud sde bzhi'i 'chad nyan dar rgyas su mdzad pas gdan sa chen po 'di nyid kyi gdan rabs kyi thog ma rgyal ba rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/

gdan sa gnyis pa mus chen sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa 'jam dbyangs shes rab rgya mtsho/ bzhi pa rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug lnga pa mkhas grub dpal ldan rdo rje/ drug pa kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge bdun pa yongs 'dzin dkon mchog 'phel/ brgyad pa 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen/ dgu pa rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge bcu pa thams cad mkhyen pa dkon chog lhun grub/ bcu gcig pa rje btsun sangs rgyas seng ge bcu gnyis pa rje dkon mchog dpal ldan/ bcu gsum pa paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / bcu bzhi pa byams pa kun dga' bkra shis/ bco lnga pa mkhas grub dpal ldan don grub/ bcu drug pa rje nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bcu bdun pa shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ bco brgyad pa rgyal rtse bdag po byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ bcu dgu pa mkhas btsun nam mkha' rin chen/ nyi shu pa rje btsun bsod nams rgya mtsho/ nyer gcig pa rje dpal mchog rgyal mtshan/ nyer gnyis pa ngor chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / nyer gsum pa gsang bdag lhun grub dpal ldan/ nyer bzhi pa sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ nyer lnga pa rgyal sras sangs rgyas bstan 'dzin/ nyer drug pa mkhan chen shes bya bzang po/ nyer bdun pa 'jam mgon tshul khrims dpal bzang / nyer brgyad pa mkhas btsun bsod nams dpal ldan/ nyer dgu pa grub dbang bsod nams bzang po/ sum cu pa 'jam mgon bkra shis lhun grub/ so gcig pa mkhas dbang tshul khrims lhun grub/ so gnyis pa thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam grub kun dga' mtshan dpe'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ so gsum pa sku drin mtshungs med 'jam mgon dpal ldan chos skyong / so bzhi pa paṇ+ḍita sangs rgyas dpal bzang / so lnga pa mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ so drug pa shar chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs rin chen mi 'gyur rgyal mtshan/ so bdun pa dpal e waṃ pa chen po 'jam mgon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal snga nas te chos grwa chen po ngor gyi gdan rabs kyis bskor ba la rje btsun sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur gyi srung ma dkar bdud lcam dral dang bcas pa la rang re mchod yon rnams gus 'dud kyi tshul du gnas pa lags/

༈ g.yon gnyis pa'i rten gtso sa lugs kyi bstan 'dzin ngor rdzong gnyis las rdzong chung pa sngags 'chang gzungs kyi dpal ba'i srol 'dzin sa lugs yab chos spyi dang khyad par dpal kyai rdo rje'i rgyud kyi bka' 'dzin pa la 'gran zla dang bral ba rdzong pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan nam mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal dang / de nyid kyi srol 'dzin kun mkhyen rdo rje gdan pa thu btsun kun dga' rnam rgyal dpal bzang po zhes rnam snang rdo rje bdud 'joms kyi rnam sprul de nyid dang / rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud rim pa las 'ongs pa'i gser chos mtha' dag gi bdag po rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi rnam sprul tshar chen rdo rje 'chang blo gsal rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po rnams la sa skya par bka' babs tshe lha gsum dang chos rje khu dbon sogs kyi zhal slob drag gras tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ grub thob yon tan dpal/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ shar pa dus 'khor ba 'jam dbyangs rin chen rgyal mtshan/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan rnams dang / rdzong lugs dang gong dkar ba'i bla ma brgyud rim gyis bskor ba la rje btsun gong ma'i dbang lha'i gtso bo dmar po skor gsum dang bcas par rang re mchod yon rnams gus 'dud kyi tshul du gnas pa lags/ ༈ g.yas gsum pa'i rten gtso grub pa'i slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi rnam sprul pa ngor sde gsum la lhag par spyan ras kyis gzigs pa grub thob kyi 'khor lo bsgyur ba chen po dpal lcags zam pa thang stong rgyal po dang / slob dpon dpal ldan chos grags kyi dgongs don bzhin bdag nyid chen po sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas legs par bkral ba'i sde bdun mdo dang bcas pa'i dgongs don gtso gyur gyi rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi bshad srol spel ba la 'gran zla dang bral ba kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams seng ge

sngags 'chang bdud kyi stobs 'phrog ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen rnams la sa skya par bka' babs kyi lha khro bo'i rgyal po sme brtsegs dud kha/ rje btsun mi g.yo ba sngon po/ 'phags pa seng ge sgra rnams dang / sa lugs kha'u brag rdzong pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa'i mkhas grub kyi gras rje btsun rdo ring pa chen po kun bzang chos kyi nyi ma blo ldan shes rab kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rje btsun sgo rum pa chen po kun dga' legs pa'i blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ tshar chen rje rten gtsos go bcad/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug bod mkhar ba mai tri don grub rgyal mtshan/ yol mkhan chen gzhon nu blo gros/ sdings ma ba mkhan chen bslab gsum dbang phyug bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po/ rta ra ba sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ paṇ+ḍi ta mang thos klu sgrub rgya mtsho/ rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ mkhan chen thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang chos grags/ rje btsun bka' 'gyur ba chen po bsod nams mchog ldan/ mkhan chen zhwa lu ba chen po rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ mkhas grub ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ grub mchog ka ye bstan pa rab rgyas/ bco brgyad chen mo rdo rje 'chang mkhyen rab byams pa ngag dbang lhun grub/ rmor chen chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' lhun grub/ rje btsun zhwa lu ba rat+na mañdzu shrī/ rje sgro mo lung pa chen po mang thos bsod nams chos 'phel/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas theg mchog bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po'am mtshan gzhan 'jam dbyangs ngag gi dbang phyug rgyal mtshan rab brtan dpal bzang po'i zhal snga nas/ brag rtsa rdo rje 'chang blo gsal bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po pa ste kha'u brag rdzong sa lugs kyi bla brgyud rags rim dang / chos rje khu dbon gyi bshad rgyun 'dzin pa la 'gran zla dang bral ba dpal sa skya'i sprul pa'i lha khang chen mo'i 'dus tshogs kyi mkhan rabs las/

thog ma'i mkhan rin po che sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po ngag dbang kun dga' rin chen gyi dbu bla paṇ+ḍi ta legs pa'i blo gros/ gdan sa gnyis pa lha khang bzang po/ gsum pa kun dga' bkra shis/ bzhi pa dpal 'byor rnam rgyal/ lnga pa dpal mgon rin chen/ drug pa kun dga' rin chen/ bdun pa ngag dbang grags pa/ brgyad pa rin chen blo gros/ dgu pa phun tshogs rin chen/ bcu pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ bcu gcig pa bsam gtan rgya mtsho/ bcu gnyis pa bsod nams bkra shis/ bcu gsum pa ngag dbang kun rgyal/ bcu bzhi pa don grub legs bzang / bco lnga pa ye shes rgya mtsho/ bcu drug pa bsam gtan lhun po/ bcu bdun pa byams pa bkra shis/ bco brgyad pa kun dga' bstan 'dzin/ bcu dgu pa dge 'dun 'phel/ nyi shu pa bsod nams bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/ nyer gcig pa rin chen chos bshad/ nyer gnyis pa kho bos rab byung mkhan po dbang phyug phun tshogs/ nyer gsum pa kho bos rab byung slob dpon kun dga' zla 'od rnams dang / nyer bzhi pa brtson 'grus ye shes dang / nyer lnga pa chos bkra shis gnyis ni kho bo sbyin bdag tu bris pa'i drung na yod pa ste thub bstan lha khang chen po'i mkhan rabs dang / yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i bshad grwa'i gtso bo dpal shākya mchog ldan gyi gdan sa gser mdog can gyi gdan rabs las/ paṇa chen shākya'i mtshan can nyid ni rten gtsos 'thus shing / gdan sa gnyis pa rting skyes pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ gsum pa spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bzhi pa don yod grub pa/ lnga pa brag dkar sems dpa' chen po/ drug pa blo gros bzang po/ bdun pa 'jam dbyangs dpal bzang / brgyad pa 'bum phrag gsum pa/ dgu pa dpal mchog bzang po/ bcu pa zla ba bzang po/ bcu gcig pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ bcu gnyis pa karma bzang po/ bcu gsum pa 'jam mgon lhun grub/ bcu bzhi pa shākya bstan 'dzin/ bco lnga pa rdo rje lhun grub/

bcu drug pa yon tan grags pa rnams kyis bskor ba la rje btsun gong ma'i nor lha'i gtso bo dzam bha la dmar ser nag gsum dang bcas par rang cag mchod yon rnams gus 'dud kyi tshul du gnas pa lags/ ༈ g.yon gsum pa'i rten gtso sngags 'chang thams cad mkhyen pa 'jam mgon a mes zhabs/ mkhas grub sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ bka' drin mtshungs med ngor chen dpal ldan chos skyong rnams la sngags 'chang rgya gar shes bzang man chad kyi gdung rgyud phal cher gyi thugs dam gras gu ru drag dmar mnga' bdag myangs lugs/ sa skya par bka' babs rdo rje rnam 'joms ba ri lugs dang / ri khrod ma ser mo sa lugs bstan 'dzin bgres kha zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ snye thang pa shes rab rdo rje/ rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal/ gzhung brgya pa dngos grub dpal 'bar/ dpal sa skya'i bde chen gling gi mkhan rin po che sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po'i dbu bla dpal ldan bzang po/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs kyi dbu bla mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan rnams dang / sa lugs bshad grwa'i gtso bo kun mkhyen chos kyi rgyal po'i gdan sa dpal thub bstan rnam rgyal gyi gdan rabs las kun mkhyen bla ma de nyid rten gtso la yod pa dang / bdag chen ngag gi dbang phyug gdung rabs kyi gras la yod pas 'thus shing / gdan sa gnyis pa dbang phyug grub pa/ gsum pa chos grags rgya mtsho/ bzhi pa blo gros rab yangs/ lnga pa bkra shis brtan pa/ drug pa blo gros 'byung gnas/ bdun pa byams pa rab brtan/ brgyad pa chos 'od zer/ dgu pa bsod nams chos 'phel/ bcu pa bzod pa rgya mtsho/ bcu gcig pa chos rnam rgyal/ bcu gnyis pa don grub dpal bzang / bcu gsum pa ngag dbang brtan pa'i rdo rje/ bcu bzhi pa bkra shis chos 'phel/ bco lnga pa bsod nams blo gros/ bcu drug pa chos dkar rnam rgyal/

bcu bdun pa kun dga' bsod nams/ bco brgyad pa dpal 'byor rnam rgyal/ bcu dgu pa bzang po rgyal mtshan/ nyi shu pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ nyer gcig pa rdo rje rnam rgyal/ nyer gnyis pa rnam rgyal bzang po rnams dang / yang gser mdog can gdan rabs kyis 'phros/ bcu bdun pa kun dga' bkra shis/ bco brgyad pa bsod nams chos 'phel/ bcu dgu pa kun dga' legs pa/ nyi shu pa rgyal ba lhun grub/ nyer gcig pa brtson 'grus phun tshogs/ nyer gnyis pa shākya phun tshogs/ nyer gsum pa blo gros phun tshogs/ nyer bzhi pa kun dga' lhun grub/ nyer lnga pa sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ nyer drug pa dar rgyas rgya mtsho/ nyer bdun pa kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ nyer brgyad pa shākya bsam 'grub/ nyer dgu pa blo gros chos 'phel/ sum cu pa shākya nor bu/ so gcig pa dpal ldan chos grags rnams dang / yang thub bstan gdan 'phros/ nyer gsum pa chos skyabs rnam rgyal/ nyer bzhi pa phun tshogs rgyal mtshan/ nyer lnga pa ngag dbang tshul khrims bzang po rnams dang / nyer drug pa klu dbang rgya mtsho dang / nyer bdun pa ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgyal mtshan gnyis 'og kho bo'i drung na yod/ yang gser can gdan 'phros/ so gnyis pa pad+ma rgya mtsho/ so gsum pa bsam gtan dpal bzang rnams kyis bskor ba la dpal sa skya'i nor lha dbyug gu mched gsum dang bcas pa rang re mchod yon rnams gus 'dud kyi tshul du gnas pa dang bcas pa ste mdor na sa lugs kyi bla ma mkhas grub rags bsdus ma tshang ba med pa la sa lugs la sku drin che ba'i bla ma yi dam chos srung nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas bzhugs pa'i sku thang 'di dag la gzungs sngags byin rlabs can du ma dang / rang gzhan la phan bde spel ba'i 'dod gsol bcas rgyab gzungs du bzhugs par nged rang nas dpal kyai rdo rje la brten pa'i rab gnas 'bring po byas nyin dpal sa skya'i gtsug lag khang rnams su stong mchod glo bur du 'bul mi 'byung ba sogs rten 'brel legs shing byin rlabs kyi gzi 'od 'bar ba'i thang chen 'di rnams rgyal khab chen po der dga' ston sogs gnas skabs bzang po rnams kyi dus su zhal 'byed mdzad pa'am/

yang na de ga'i pho brang gtsug lag khang gang 'os su rgyun 'grem la mchod pa dang bsnyen bskur bcas bzhugs su gsol rgyu 'di dag sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos lhag bsam rnam par dag pas kun nas bslangs te sa ngor gyi sbyin bdag yid bzhin nor bu khyed sde dge tshang la phul ba lags pas da dung yang sa ngor gyi bstan pa rin po che gyen du 'degs pa la thugs bskyed dam bca' 'gog med zhu/ ༈ swasti/ yang sde dge dgon chen gyi pho brang sa skyong bla ma'i gzim chung dang / bkra shis sa skyong dpon rim phebs kyi gzim chung du bzhugs rgyu'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i sku thang tsho gnyis la sa skya pa'i yab chos yang phur/ bde kye/ dus 'khor/ gsang 'dus/ gshed dmar ba/ 'jigs byed/ mkha' spyod ma/ drag dmar/ kun rig rnam snang / mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med bcas rgyud sde bzhi gtso bsdus kyi bla brgyud dang / chos skyong che chung dmar po skor gsum bcas kyi bla brgyud bzhugs pa la sku grangs nyung zhing 'khyer bde ba'i phyir bla ma gcig brgyud pa mang po la bzhugs dgos rnams gcig 'thus su byas nas khyon gyi brgyud pa'i rkang grangs 'grigs pa'i bzhugs tshul yin kyang bla ma kha shas bldabs 'dug pa bcas la/ rten gtso dpal sa skya pa chen po kun dga' snying po la/ yar phur/ kyai rdor/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ slob dpon hūm̐ ka ra/ slob dpon rin po che pad ma 'byung gnas/ 'khon klu'i dbang po/ rdo rje rin chen/ shes rab yon tan/ tshul khrims rgyal po/ rdo rje gtsug tor/ dge skyabs/ dge mthong / bal po/ shākya blo gros/ shes rab tshul khrims/ dkon mchog rgyal po/ dpal sa skya pa chen po brtse chen rin po che kun dga' snying po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/

chos kyi rje rin po che sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa rin po che blo gros rgyal mtshan/ kha'u pa 'od ldan dpal/ pu lung pa kun dga' rdo rje/ lo tsā ba mchog ldan legs pa'i blo gros dpung rgyan mdzes pa'i tog dga' ldan pa kun dga' bsod nams/ gan pa rin chen rgyal mtshan/ chos rje bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ snye thang pa shes rab rdo rje/ bla chen chos dpal shes rab/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bsod nams dar po/ dmar ston rgyal mtshan 'od zer/ chos rje nam mkha' blo gros/ chag lo tsā ba rin chen chos kyi rgyal po bla chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan/ theg chen chos kyi rgyal po/ shes rab rdo rje/ 'di bldab/ 'khon thugs rje shes rab/ sngags 'chang dharmā kīrti/ 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po/ 'jam dbyangs nam mkha' rgyal mtshan/ rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sa lo tsā ba 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags rgyal mtshan/ sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po kun dga' rin chen/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang po/ sngags 'chang grags pa blo gros/ sgo rum pa kun dga' legs pa/ 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang phyug rdo rje 'chang dbang phyug rab brtan/ spyan snga kun dga' don grub/ sgar chen mthu stobs dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' dbang rgyal/ 'jam mgon a mes zhabs ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams/ 'jam dbyangs bsod nams dbang phyug sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhan chen zhwa lu pa rin chen bsod nams mchog grub/ bla ma mchod dpon dkon mchog rgyal po/ yab rje rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams rin chen gyi zhal snga nas/ snye thang mkhan chen ngag dbang sbyin pa/ gong dkar ba chen po bsod nams blo gros kyi zhal snga nas bcas dpal chen yang dag gi dbang brgyud dang / rdo rje phur pa'i stod smad las kyi bla brgyud cha tshang zhig bzhugs pa la/

'byung 'dul/ gur lha brgyad dang / rang re mchod yon rnams kyis bskor ba/ ༈ g.yas dang po'i rten gtso slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo la dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang / bde mchog lū dril gnyis gcig 'thus dang / nag po lugs bcas la rje btsun rdo rje bdag med ma/ gsang bdag phyag na rdo rje/ grub chen sa ra ha/ 'phags pa klu sgrub/ sha wa ri/ lū hi pa/ dha ri ka dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dza len dhā ra pa/ nag po spyod pa/ gu h+ya pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ te lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa gcen 'jigs med grags pa dang gcung dus 'khor ba/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug bir+wa pa/ shar phyogs nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti pa/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs pa/ mal lo tsā ba blo gros grags pa/ se ston kun rig zhang ston chos 'bar/ 'u yug pa bsod nams seng ge zhang dkon mchog dpal/ brag phug pa bsod nams dpal/ sangs 'bum/ dpal ldan seng ge bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa rin chen grub/ khyung lhas pa gzhon nu bsod nams/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ shar chen ye shes rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ gu ge paṇ+ḍi ta grags pa rgyal mtshan/ glo bo mkhan chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rgyal tshab kun dga' dbang phyug kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge grub chen dkon mchog blo gros/ bdag chen rdo rje 'chang blo gros rgyal mtshan/ rje btsun rdo ring pa/ 'dren mchog rat+na war+dha/ rje btsun sangs rgyas rin chen/ ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub/ tshar chen chos kyi rgyal po/ mkhan chen bslab gsum dbang phyug ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang / spyan snga dkon mchog rgya mtsho/ mus chen sangs rgyas rgyal mtshan/ mgon po bsod nams mchog ldan/ ngor chen nam mkha' sangs rgyas/ bsod nams mchog grub/ sngags 'chang kun dga' bkra shis/

rmor chen kun dga' lhun grub ste kyai rdor man ngag lugs dang / bde mchog lū nag dril gsum gyi dbang brgyud phal cher dang / gur mgon chos skor gyi bla brgyud thor bu bcas la zhal gtso 'khor lnga dang rang cag mchod yon rnams kyis bskor ba/ ༈ g.yon dang po rten gtso rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan dang / dpal gsang ba 'dus pa 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ mi bskyod rdo rje/ gshin rje gshed dmar po rnams la/ rgyal chen in+d+ra bhu ti/ klu las byung ba'i ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma rgyal po bi su kalpa/ 'phags pa lha/ shākya bshes gnyen/ klu'i byang chub/ zla ba grags pa/ slob pa'i rdo rje/ sa 'dren pa/ bir+ya bha dra/ de wā ka ra tsan+d+ra/ a ti sha sangs rgyas ye shes/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde ba/ dri med sbas pa/ rin chen rdo rje/ rin chen grags pa/ bla ma paṇ+ḍe pa/ ri sul gyi rnal 'byor ma ku sa li dge ba can ma/ ḍoṃ bhi he ru ka slob dpon dpal 'dzin/ blo bzang snying po/ dar+paṇa a tsar+ya/ 'gos khug pa lhas btsas/ gnyen lo tsā ba dar ma grags/ glo bo lo tsā ba shes rab rin chen/ pa pa blo gros bzang po/ dbus pa ge ser/ gnam kha'u pa chos kyi rgyal mtshan/ gnam kha'u pa rdo rje bdud 'joms/ ri khrod pa blo gros brtan pa/ dam pa kun dga' grags/ slob dpon bkra shis dpal/ khams ston rdo rje dpal/ bla ma grags pa dpal/ kun mkhyen gangs khrod pa/ sa bzang ma ti paṇa chen/ sa bzang 'phags pa gzhon nu blo gros/ kun mkhyen jo nang pa phyogs las rnam rgyal/ mkhyen rab rin chen mchog grub/ kun mkhyen shākya don grub/ stong ra kun dga' legs grub/ she'u lo tsā ba byams pa kun dga' chos grags/ nyan chen grags pa blo gros/ shar khang pa shes rab rgyal mtshan/ sgrub khang pa dpal ldan don grub/ shar chen shes rab 'byung gnas/ bco brgyad mchog legs rdo rje/ chos rje kun dga' rnam rgyal/ bco brgyad mkhyen rab bstan 'dzin bzang po/

shar chen ye shes bzang po/ chos rje dam chos bsam grub/ mkhan chen sangs rgyas phun tshogs/ ngor chen bkra shis lhun grub/ gnas gsar rdo rje 'chang ngag dbang kun dga' legs pa'i 'byung gnas kyi zhal snga nas dang / rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / kho bo'i yongs 'dzin sa skya'i rgya mtsho dpon seng ge rgyal mtshan gyi zhal snga nas/ 'jam mgon sangs rgyas ye shes kyi zhal nas bcas gsang 'dus lugs gnyis dang gshed dmar rnams kyi dbang brgyud/ zhar la dpal mgon zhal gyi chos skor gyi brgyud pa'ang phal cher tshang ba la nor skyong dur khrod bdag po yab yum dang rang re mchod yon rnams kyis bskor ba/ ༈ g.yas gnyis pa'i rten gtso sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta kun dga' rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / khro rgyal rdo rje 'jigs byed rā lugs rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ gu ru rdo rje thod phreng rtsal rnams la bdag cag gi ston pa rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs/ za hor rgyal po rab gsal zla ba/ rab 'byor skyong / kun dga' snying po/ shes rab skyong / zhi ba snying po/ dge mtshan bshes gnyen/ bde ba'i rdo rje/ ye shes snying po/ ye shes zhi ba/ sangs rgyas zhi ba/ sangs rgyas gsang ba/ ku sa la che chung gnyis/ gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa/ shrar+dhā ka ra warma/ la li ta badz+ra/ slob dpon snying po'i zhabs/ dze ta ri dgra las rnam rgyal/ byang chub bzang po/ ting 'dzin bzang po/ lhan skyes rol pa/ bha liṃ ta pa/ rdo rje gdan pa che ba mya ngan med/ chung ba don yod rdo rje/ lo chen rin chen bzang po/ ba ri lo tsā ba rin chen grags pa/ tshogs sgom kun dga' dpal/ nyan chen bsod nams brtan pa/ shar pa rdo rje 'od zer/ bla ma bkra shis 'od zer/ e pa 'khon ston/ shar pa 'jam dbyangs chen po/ bdag nyid chen po bzang po dpal/ ti shrī kun dga' blo gros/ byang sems rgyal ba ye shes/ grags pa dpal/ spru lung pa kun dga' smon lam/ rgyal tsha lung mang po/

mkhas pa yon tan khri/ mkhan chen seng ge bzang po/ yar lung pa seng ge rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen rgyal ba mchog dbyangs/ snur ston ye shes rgyal mtshan/ snur ston chos 'phags/ gar thig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ lo tsā ba ma ṇi ka shrī/ rgyal ba lha mchog seng ge ngor chen sangs rgyas seng ge sngags 'chang bsod nams chos 'phel/ thar rtse nam mkha' rin chen/ thar rtse nam mkha' dpal bzang / chos rje shes rab rgya mtsho/ rje ngag dbang rnam rgyal/ ngor chen tshul khrims dpal bzang / khang gsar chos rje bsod nams bzang po/ thar rtse rdo rje 'chang nam mkha' bsam 'grub kyi zhal snga nas bcas kun rig mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med rnams kyi dbang brgyud dang / zhar la rig byed ma'i chos skor gyi brgyud pa'ang phal cher tshang ba la dkar bdud lcam dral dang rang re mchod yon bcas kyis bskor ba/ ༈ g.yon gnyis pa'i rten gtso bla chen chos kyi rgyal po 'phags pa rin po dang / rnam snang / mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med rnams la/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs/ chos rgyal zla ba bzang po/ lha yi dbang po/ gzi brjid can/ rgyal bas byin/ lha'i dbang phyug sna tshogs gzugs/ lha'i dbang ldan/ 'jam dbyangs grags pa/ pad+ma dkar po/ bzang po rnam rgyal/ bshes gnyen bzang po/ rin chen phyag khyab 'jug sbas pa/ nyi ma grags pa/ shin tu bzang po/ rgya mtsho rnam rgyal/ rgyal dka'/ nyi ma/ zla ba'i 'od/ sna tshogs gzugs/ sa skyong / mtha' yas gnyen/ seng ge dpal skyong / rnam gnon/ stobs po che/ ma 'gags pa/ mi'i seng ge dbang phyug chen po/ mtha' yas rnam rgyal/ drag po 'khor lo can/ bal po hang du dkar po/ ta thā ga ta rak+ṣi ta/ mnga' bdag myang ral yab sras/ gu ru dharma rat+na/ rtogs ldan chos nyid rang grol/ drin chen sangs rgyas lhun dbang / sprul sku kun dga' bkra shis/ mkhas grub rgyal sras chos rje/ sngags 'chang legs pa dpal bzang / rin po che skyob pa dpal/

rje shes rab seng ge bag ston gzhon nu tshul khrims/ bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen byang chub seng ge bla ma bsod nams 'bum/ bla ma ngag gi dbang phyug gu ru shes rab bzang po/ 'jam dbyangs bkra shis rin chen/ rtse gdong khri chen bsod nams lhun grub/ rgyal rtse bdag po byams pa ngag dbang bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ ngor chen lhun grub dpal ldan/ mkhan rin po che dpal ldan chos skyong dang bcas pa ste byang sham+bha la'i chos rgyal rigs ldan rnams dang / drag dmar gyi dbang brgyud/ tshogs bdag 'dod rgyal gnyis kyi chos skor gyi brgyud pa'ang phal cher tshang ba la dbang lha dmar po skor gsum dang rang cag mchod yon rnams dang bcas pas bskor ba'i sku thang rgyab gzungs 'dod gsol bcas bzhugs pa 'di rnams la nged rang nas gong gi thang sku che ba rnams dang lhan cig rab gnas bgyis te sde dge pho brang / le tshan gyi gzims chung thang khar phul ba lags pas khyed rgyal brgyud rim can nas thugs dam gyi rten du bdag gis bzhengs te sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa'i ring lugs bzang po 'di la rtse gcig gus 'dud kyi sgo nas pha mes bzang po rim byon gyi phyag rgyun spyan ltos ltar mchod pa dang / bsnyen bkur gyi gnas su mdzad pas gnas skabs su sa skyong sde dge tshang gi chos srid dpal 'byor dpag bsam shing ltar rgyas shing / de la dpal sa skya'i chos srung rnams 'go zhing 'ches pa dang / mthar thug rang re 'brel thogs thams cad rje btsun gong ma rdo rje 'chang dang zhal mi gnyis pa de dag gi go 'phang thob nas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por 'gyur ba lags pas de ltar thugs la 'jog par zhu/ 'di ni dkar chag mdor bsdus bsnyel tho lta bu yin la/ rgyas par na yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams spyi bye brag gi gdul bya la bka' drin che tshul las gleng ste rje btsun sa skya pa'i bzhed srol sde snod gsum dang rgyu sde bzhi'i bshad sgrub 'di gzhan nas khyad par 'phags tshul dang /

de 'dzin gyi skyes chen dam pa gdung rabs rim byon/ zhal slob pa rim byon dang bcas pa rnams kyis rtogs brjod rgya cher spel ba dkar chag shin tu rgyas shing dad pa yod pa dang gzu bor gnas pa'i blo can rnams kyi rgyud la dge legs kyi sa bon 'bad med du 'jog par 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i dkar chag nyung bsdus 'di yang sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos dpal sa skya'i bzhi thog bla brang gi yang steng rang nyid kyi bsti gnas 'dzam gling phun tshogs dpal 'bar du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni gzhu lung pa bsod nams 'od zer ro/ /'dis bstan pa dang sems can la phan thogs par gyur cig/ //kā l+ya na war+dhan+tu// // PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 kun dga' blo gros/ sde dge chos rgyal rin chen gyi thugs dam dad rten thang sku bcu bdun gyi dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
